window.caveat: Expected talk time is inbound talk time on forecast calls only: predicted calls times the average handle time for that weekday and hour. It excludes outbound follow-up and after-call work. Handle times are recency-weighted means of answered inbound calls in the calls table, excluding calls recorded with zero agent time.

Expected talk time is inbound talk time on forecast calls only: predicted calls times the average handle time for that weekday and hour. It excludes outbound follow-up and after-call work. Handle times are recency-weighted means of answered inbound calls in the calls table, excluding calls recorded with zero agent time.
